output.summary: A genus of mostly herbaceous perennial flowering plants native chiefly to North America, including Mexico, with a few species native to South America and Eurasia. Goldenrods usually bear many bright golden-yellow flower heads in late summer and can spread by wind-borne seed or underground rhizomes that form colonies.
output.edibilityNote: Young leaves are edible; herbal teas are sometimes made, and Native Americans traditionally ate seeds of some species.
